unity-rag.description: Unity 6000.3 knowledge base - tools: unity_rag_search, unity_rag_status. Hybrid search (dense + BM25, RRF-fused) over the pinned Manual, Scripting API, cookbook, rules, anti-patterns and troubleshooting, plus whatever Unity project is indexed as source=project. Call unity_rag_search BEFORE answering a Unity API question or writing C#: it is the pinned 6000.3 text, not a model's memory of an older Unity.

unity-project.description: Unity project tools: read/write C# and assets, validate (lint or full compile), run an editor method, read the live console. Project root comes from data\active_project.txt; a batch gate needs the editor at UNITY_EDITOR.

assets.description: Local asset generation - the FIRST tier of ASSET-POLICY. Call one of these BEFORE downloading art or reaching for a cloud generator (ImageGen/VideoGen and any hosted API are not a route): text-to-image with z-image-turbo (:8687), background removal, image-to-3D (Pixal3D/TRELLIS.2 via ComfyUI :8188), whole-pack runs. Tools: asset_image, asset_edit, asset_remove_bg, asset_to_3d, asset_character, asset_generate_pack, assets_status. Use it whenever a task needs a texture, sprite, background, key art or a 3D model - even when the user did not say 'generate'. One asset_generate_pack call per pack, never one call per asset. The 7200 s timeout covers a pack of several 3D models - a legitimately long silence, do not retry it. For Roblox: generated images are decals/UI, generated meshes are imported through Studio's Asset Manager.
